The retry failed on the same missing `@esbuild/win32-x64` executable, which means npm’s partial install is stuck.

I’m going to remove only this project’s `node_modules` and lockfile after confirming the resolved paths are inside the current directory, then install fresh.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$root=(Resolve-Path .).Path; $targets=@('"'node_modules','package-lock.json') | ForEach-Object { Join-Path "'$root $_ }; $targets | ForEach-Object { if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $_){ $resolved=(Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $_).Path; if($resolved.StartsWith($root)){ Write-Output "Removing $resolved"; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $resolved -Recurse -Force } else { throw "Refusing outside workspace: $resolved" } } }'
